""
I have found an insightful article titled "Kate Spade and Co. Exec: This Is How I Pick Perfect Teammates" by Mary Beech:https://time.com/4388615/kate-spade-team-building/, Executive Vice President and Chief Marketing Officer of Kate Spade & Company. In this piece, Beech shares her experiences and principles for building effective teams, drawing from her tenure at The Walt Disney Company and Kate Spade & Company.
Beech emphasizes five key principles for creating a powerful team:
Passion Over Perfect Qualifications: She advocates for selecting team members who exhibit genuine passion, as it drives sustained performance and commitment.
Consider the Whole Person: Beyond credentials, understanding a candidate's interests and motivations ensures better team synergy and creativity.
Diversity Over Homogeneity: Building a diverse team with complementary skills, rather than hiring in one's likeness, fosters innovation and growth.
Encourage Confidence Through 'Plusing': Adopting the concept of 'plusing'—enhancing ideas collaboratively—encourages continuous improvement and confidence among team members.
Active Listening: Truly paying attention to team members' input fosters collaboration and innovation, reinforcing a culture of mutual respect.
